meaning: Running row number in the sheet.
audit_note: Meaningless for modelling; never a feature.

meaning: Employee code. EMP-xxxx = master-snapshot employee, HIST-xxxx = simulated history.
audit_note: Use as the GROUP key when splitting data so one person is never in train and test.

meaning: The day the features were measured (30 Sep 2025 for master-snapshot staff, 2021-2025 for history).
audit_note: Use for time-aware splits, not as a feature.

meaning: Department code D00-D10 (D01 Engineering ... D10 Legal).
audit_note: D00 Executive never appears in this table.

meaning: Job role code (48 distinct roles).
Seniority level 1 (associate) to 6 (head).
Office city.
Onsite, Hybrid or Remote.
Permanent or fixed-term contract.
audit_note: Contract staff are only 6% of rows.

meaning: Highest qualification, 27 free-text values.
audit_note: 15 blanks. Many near-duplicate labels (B.E. vs B.Tech).

meaning: Months with the company at the observation date.
Years of work in total: earlier jobs plus time here.
audit_note: Some values are negative or smaller than tenure.

meaning: How many employers the person had before joining.
Home-to-office distance in km.
Yearly fixed salary in INR.
Pay divided by the role's mid-point; below 1 = underpaid.
Number of pay revisions since joining.
Size of the most recent raise (%).
Months since the last raise (or since joining if none).
Number of promotions since joining.
Months since the last promotion.
Moves between departments.
Latest appraisal rating, 1-5.
audit_note: Blank = joined under 12 months ago, no appraisal yet.

meaning: Latest engagement survey score, 1-5.
Times the manager changed in the last year.
Training hours in the last year.
Share of scheduled days attended, last 3 months (0-1).
Late check-ins in the last 3 months.
Average monthly overtime hours.
Average hours per working day.
Share of days worked from home (0-1).
audit_note: Many values slightly below 0 or above 1.

meaning: Unpaid leave days, last 6 months.
Paid leave days, last 6 months.
Share of the department that left in the 12 months BEFORE the snapshot.
audit_note: Legitimate (looks backwards), but confirm with the Python team.

meaning: TARGET: 1 if the person left within 12 months after the observation date.
1 if they resigned (rather than being let go). A sub-type of the target.
audit_note: Known only once someone has left.

meaning: Where the row came from: master snapshot or historical extension.
audit_note: Describes data origin, not the employee. Drop from features.

meaning: Last working day. Blank for people who stayed.
audit_note: Filled for exactly the rows where target = 1.

meaning: Day the resignation was submitted.
audit_note: Only exists for people who resigned.

meaning: Reason recorded when leaving.
Y/N: was an exit interview held.
Full-and-final settlement paid at exit.
